summary: Read two integer sequences of equal length. The first records a preorder visit of some binary tree, and the second records an inorder visit of that same tree. All node values are distinct. The opening value of the preorder sequence is the root. In the inorder sequence the segment on its left forms the left side and the segment on its right forms the right side. Split both sides by the same rule. Write the rebuilt tree. Either sequence may be empty, and empty sequences correspond to an empty tree.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
